program: Wingless RSI corrective tranche: prospective applicability-region attribution
question: After R39 showed that adding all fixed pairwise BASE6 interactions leaves held-out sign error unchanged, is the residual failure concentrated outside the support region represented by the three training manifests rather than caused by missing low-order feature interactions?
hypothesis: R39 falsified a bounded pairwise-interaction explanation: BASE6_PAIRWISE preserved sign error at 0.5151515 and slightly worsened MAE. Freeze a support-region attribution with no learned threshold. For each outer holdout, build the byte-identical R39/R38 BASE6 training examples from the three training manifests. For each of the six BASE6 coordinates, freeze the closed interval [training minimum, training maximum] before any held-out outcome is read. A held-out R30-excluded case is IN_ENVELOPE only if all six held-out BASE6 coordinates lie within their frozen intervals; otherwise it is OUT_OF_ENVELOPE. Evaluate the byte-identical raw BASE6 predictor separately in those regions. This tests whether the learned marginal-value signal has a bounded applicability domain already implied by observed training support.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: fixed pairwise interactions among the six BASE6 internal conditions are sufficient to recover the residual held-out calibration signal
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: the marginal-value predictor may only be applicable within a bounded region of feature support already represented by the training manifests

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: R39's 15 fixed pairwise interactions changed neither sign error nor materially changed MAE, despite clean identity and deterministic replay.
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: add only a deterministic training-envelope applicability label to the byte-identical BASE6 predictor; predictor, targets, manifests, solver, budget, exact R30 exclusion and held-out ordering remain unchanged
cause_effect_trace.control_rule: GLOBAL_BASE6 reports the byte-identical R39/R38 raw BASE6 predictor on all exact R30-excluded cases
cause_effect_trace.applicability_rule: IN_ENVELOPE iff every one of the six held-out BASE6 feature coordinates is within the inclusive minimum/maximum observed over all training examples from the three training manifests for that outer holdout; otherwise OUT_OF_ENVELOPE
cause_effect_trace.no_threshold_rule: no quantile, margin threshold, normalization, distance weight, learned boundary, held-out tuning, or post-result region choice
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: R40 is attribution only. Support authorizes only separately preregistered support-gated correction or prospective validation; allocator behavior remains unchanged.

frozen_reuse.envelope_bounds: inclusive coordinate-wise min/max over frozen training BASE6 examples

classification_rules.supported: valid AND in_envelope_coverage>=0.25 AND in_envelope_sign_error_improvement>=0.15 AND out_minus_in_sign_error_gap>=0.15
classification_rules.mixed: valid AND in_envelope_coverage>=0.25 AND in_envelope_sign_error_rate<global_sign_error_rate AND out_of_envelope_sign_error_rate>in_envelope_sign_error_rate but one or more supported thresholds are missed
classification_rules.negative: valid AND supported is false AND mixed is false
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest identity, 1744 budget, exact R30 exclusion, BASE6 predictor identity, six-dimensional inclusive min/max envelope, held-out ordering, deterministic replay, provenance or accounting requirement fails

rsi_success_note: R40 is applicability attribution on studied manifests. No policy is changed and any support requires separately frozen prospective validation on disjoint future contexts.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter manifests, BASE6, training envelope definition, predictor, thresholds, exclusion set, budget/capacity, held-out ordering, classification or authority after primary output.
